title: Multicolor nonlinear chiral quantum optics: beyond phase
summary: Chiral quantum nonlinearities that arise when light interacts with quantum emitters are known to modulate only the phase but not the amplitude of scattered photons, enabling the creation of non-reciprocal photonic elements, quantum logic gates, and quantum network protocols. In this work, we show that the addition of a second photon beam drastically changes this picture, enabling both phase and amplitude modulation.
